sections.content: Hypothetical situations commonly use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional. At B1, focus on clear, realistic-to-imaginary contrasts such as Si no *tuviéramos* internet, *dependeríamos* *más* *del* *teléfono*. También se puede usar me *costaría*, *sería* *difícil* and *podría*.

items.spanish: Si no tuviéramos internet, dependeríamos más del teléfono.
items.english: If we did not have internet, we would depend more on the telephone.

items.spanish: Si no hubiera acceso digital, sería más difícil trabajar desde casa.
items.english: If there were no digital access, it would be harder to work from home.

items.spanish: Me costaría mucho prescindir del teléfono.
items.english: It would be very difficult for me to do without my phone.

items.spanish: Sin esta tecnología, podría comunicarme de otra manera.
items.english: Without this technology, I could communicate in another way.

sections.content: For unreal or hypothetical present situations, use si + imperfect subjunctive followed by the conditional.
